children: RNS Number : 5569T  Roebuck Food Group PLC  04 September 2026
Roebuck Food Group plc ("Roebuck" or "the Company")

Roebuck Food Group plc is pleased to announce that its wholly owned subsidiary Moorhead & McGavin Limited has successfully completed the sale and leaseback of its freehold property in Motherwell for £900,000 (net £850,000) after costs to an independent Scottish property investment company on 3 September 2026.
The lease is for 10 years with a break in year 5. The agreed annual rent is £90,000 per annum for the first 5 years, and the lease is guaranteed by Roebuck.
The Company was advised on the transaction by property experts Burnett Real Estate and the legals were handled by Brodies LLP.
